products.name: Endpoint Analytics Deployment & Optimization in Microsoft Intune — Startup, Reliability & Work-From-Anywhere Scores — Commercial
products.short_description: Turn on Endpoint Analytics, baseline your startup, reliability, and work-from-anywhere scores, and drive a measurable improvement plan — so you manage the endpoint experience by data, not by ticket volume.
products.description:
Turn on Endpoint Analytics, baseline your startup, reliability, and work-from-anywhere scores, and drive a measurable improvement plan — so you manage the endpoint experience by data, not by ticket volume.

Most endpoint teams have no objective measure of the user experience — they learn about slow boots, unreliable apps, and struggling remote devices only when tickets pile up. Endpoint Analytics gives Intune a data plane for exactly that: startup performance, application and device reliability, work-from-anywhere readiness, and resource performance, scored and benchmarked. This solution deploys Endpoint Analytics end to end, establishes a baseline across a pilot then the fleet, interprets each score and its sub-signals, and turns them into a prioritized remediation backlog — with the Proactive Remediations engine and the reliability/anomaly signals pointed to their dedicated companion products for depth.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Enable + configure Endpoint Analytics — data collection policy, device scope, baseline selection, and what each score (Startup, Reliability, Work-From-Anywhere, Resource Performance) actually measures
  • Baseline + benchmark — establish a pilot baseline, compare to the org/industry baseline, and read the sub-signals behind a low score
  • Startup performance — boot/sign-in phase breakdown and the levers that move it (policy, app, driver, hardware) as a prioritized backlog
  • Work-From-Anywhere + resource performance — cloud-identity/management/Autopilot readiness and CPU/RAM spotlight, turned into targeted actions
  • Operationalize — a repeatable review cadence and improvement loop; pointers to the Proactive Remediations product (script-pack remediation) and the Anomaly Detection & Application Reliability product for deep dives

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An Endpoint Analytics deployment that gives you an objective, benchmarked view of the endpoint experience and a prioritized plan to improve it — managed by data instead of ticket volume.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENDPTAN-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for Endpoint Analytics deployment
    • ENDPTAN-Report.ps1 — export an Endpoint Analytics score / sub-signal summary to CSV
    • ENDPTAN-Set-DataCollection.ps1 — create/assign the Endpoint Analytics data-collection policy
    • ENDPTAN-Test-DataFlow.ps1 — confirm pilot devices are submitting Endpoint Analytics data
    • ENDPTAN-Validate.ps1 — prove the Endpoint Analytics pilot is ready to baseline (PASS/FAIL gate)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
